suites.title: build-the-full-permit2-permit-management.spec.ts
US-0.1 — Login to Permit2

specs.title: A styled login page is displayed at /login with email and password fields and a Sign In button
Submitting valid credentials redirects to the dashboard (/dashboard)
Invalid credentials show a generic inline error "Invalid email or password."
Empty email or password fields show an inline validation error before any API call is made

suites.title: US-0.3 — Log Out Securely

specs.title: A Logout control is visible in the navigation header on authenticated pages
Clicking Logout redirects the user to /login

suites.title: US-0.4 — Be Redirected to Login When Accessing Protected Routes Unauthenticated

specs.title: Accessing /dashboard without being logged in redirects to /login
Accessing /permits without being logged in redirects to /login

suites.title: US-1.1 — View Permit Status Overview at a Glance

specs.title: Dashboard displays stat cards for Total Permits, Pending, Approved, Rejected, Revoked
Dashboard page heading "Dashboard" is visible after login

suites.title: US-1.2 — View a Visual Status Breakdown Chart

specs.title: A chart labeled "Permits by Status" is rendered on the dashboard

suites.title: US-1.3 — Review Recent Permit Activity

specs.title: Recent Activity panel is visible on the dashboard
A "View all permits" link is visible that navigates to /permits

suites.title: US-1.4 — Navigate to Create a Permit from the Dashboard

specs.title: A "Create New Permit" button is visible on the dashboard
Clicking "Create New Permit" navigates to /permits/new

suites.title: US-2.1 — Create a New Permit Request

specs.title: The creation form at /permits/new contains fields for Title, Permit Type, Applicant Name, Start Date, End Date, Description
On successful submission, the permit is saved and the user is navigated to the new permit's detail view

suites.title: US-2.3 — Select a Permit Type from a Predefined List

specs.title: Permit Type field is a dropdown with options: Work Permit, Access Permit, Activity Authorization, Safety Permit, Other

suites.title: US-3.1 — View All Permits in a Paginated Table

specs.title: The permit list at /permits displays a table with columns including Title, Type, Applicant, Status
Status is displayed as a color-coded badge

suites.title: US-3.3 — Navigate to a Permit's Detail View from the List

specs.title: Clicking a permit row navigates to /permits/:id

suites.title: US-4.1 — Search Permits by Title, Applicant, or Description

specs.title: A search input is displayed above the permit table with placeholder "Search permits by title, applicant, or description…"

suites.title: US-4.2 — Filter Permits by Status

specs.title: A status filter offers options including Pending, Approved, Rejected, Revoked
Selecting a status filters the list

suites.title: US-5.1 — View Full Permit Information on a Dedicated Page

specs.title: Detail page at /permits/:id displays Title, Type, Applicant Name, Status
The current status is shown as a prominently placed color-coded badge

suites.title: US-5.2 — View the Permit's Status History Timeline

specs.title: A Status History timeline panel is displayed on the permit detail page
The initial Created — PENDING event is present

suites.title: US-5.3 — Navigate Using Breadcrumbs and Back Links

specs.title: A breadcrumb trail is shown at the top of the permit detail page
A Back to Permits link is available

suites.title: US-6.1 — Approve a Pending Permit

specs.title: An Approve button is visible on the detail page when the permit status is PENDING
Clicking Approve opens a confirmation dialog
Confirming approval updates the status to APPROVED

suites.title: US-6.2 — Reject a Pending Permit with an Optional Reason

specs.title: A Reject button is visible on the detail page when the permit status is PENDING
Clicking Reject opens a confirmation dialog with an optional Rejection Reason text field
Confirming rejection updates the status to REJECTED

suites.title: US-6.3 — Revoke an Approved Permit

specs.title: A Revoke button is visible on the detail page when the permit status is APPROVED
Confirming revocation updates the status to REVOKED

suites.title: US-7.4 — Receive Transient Toast Notifications for Actions

specs.title: Success toast appears after approving a permit
Success toast appears after rejecting a permit

suites.title: US-8.1 — Have All Permit Actions Backed by a Reliable REST API

specs.title: GET /api/permits returns a list of permits when authenticated
GET /api/permits/stats returns permit counts when authenticated
